speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, night sweats, chest pain, or swelling in the legs. She has not noticed any changes in bowel or urinary habits. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The combination of a large ovarian mass, ascites causing abdominal distension and shortness of breath, and elevated CA-125 is highly suggestive of ovarian malignancy, likely epithelial ovarian cancer. I will proceed with further staging to confirm the extent of the disease.

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest X-Ray: Right-sided pleural effusion. Pelvic Ultrasound: Large mass in the right ovary, significant ascites present.

speaker: Doctor
text: The triad of ovarian mass, ascites, and pleural effusion confirms Meigs' syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign ovarian fibroma
